d: Job Purpose: Responsible for managing and coordinating all centralized support functions across Alfeyhaa Rest House, Sahab Resort, cafés, catering and events businesses, including finance, human resources, purchasing, information technology, asset management, administration and corporate support.
q: Professional accounting qualification or Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.
10+ years of relevant experience in finance, administration or business operations.
Strong knowledge of accounting, financial controls, human resources, purchasing and administration.
Experience managing centralise functions across multiple business units preferred.
Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted
r: Oversee finance and accounting across all business units, including reporting, budgeting, cash flow, payments and collections.
Monitor financial performance, expenses and profitability, and ensure effective controls and compliance.
Coordinate annual audits and tax matters.
Oversee recruitment, payroll, employee records, leave, benefits and staff administration.
Develop HR policies and performance review procedures.
Coordinate manpower planning, training and staffing with property managers.
Ensure compliance with Oman Labour Law and employment regulations.
Oversee centralized purchasing, supplier selection, negotiations and purchase orders.
Manage supplier contracts, purchasing controls and cost-saving initiatives.
Coordinate purchasing across business units and maintain inventory controls and documentation.
Manage IT systems and business software, including hotel, billing and accounting systems.

Oversee approved renovations, refurbishments and capital projects.
Manage company administration, licenses, permits, contracts and records.

Coordinate with auditors, legal advisers, consultants and government authorities.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and contracts.
Review organizational structures, reporting lines and job responsibilities.
Establish clear procedures and departmental responsibilities.
Identify process gaps and improve coordination and efficiency across business units.
Prepare consolidated financial, administrative and management reports.
Monitor budgets, performance and management decisions.
Coordinate centralized support with property managers.
Report significant matters to Group Management.

d: Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.
Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks where the use case requires them
Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation where the use case calls for them
Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership
Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
Experience owning the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
Experience designing evaluations that tie model behaviour to real-world outcomes, and using them to catch regressions
Experience leading root-cause analysis on a production AI or ML system
Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
Experience handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.
PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.

To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.

Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.

To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.

As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
q: Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
Familiarity with public or private cloud management
